pa-topic-rules.txt:
Pennsylvania policy topic coding rules from reviewed examples and guideline excerpts:
- Assign the narrowest topic matching the bill summary's substantive subject.
- Public School Code provisions concerning agreements between school districts are elementary/secondary education (602).
- Municipal and residual waste facility siting or host municipality agreements and related moratoria concern solid/hazardous waste management (703).
- Freezing assets of criminal defendants is criminal justice procedure (1204).
- Defining racketeering activity under Crimes and Offenses is crime and criminal code (1202).
- Do not let the statute title alone override the policy subject; use the specific action and affected area in the summary.
